definition.title: Plant definition
definition.body: This is a placeholder modal. Plant definition details will be implemented later.

changeImage.title: Change image
changeImage.subtitle: When you save, your photo is resized and uploaded to private server storage. Only you and people with active sharing access to this plant can view it.
changeImage.loadFailed: Could not load the photo. Try again.
changeImage.permissionCamera: Please allow camera access to take a photo.
changeImage.permissionGallery: Please grant media permission to pick a photo.
changeImage.saveFailedMsg: Could not upload this photo. Your previous photo has been kept.
changeImage.confirmRemoveMsg: The photo will be removed after you press Save.
changeImage.confirmDiscardMsg: Your changes will not be saved.
changeImage.removeFailedMsg: Could not remove the photo. Try again.
changeImage.invalidPhoto: Choose a valid JPEG or PNG photo up to 5 MB.
changeImage.uploadTooLarge: This photo is too large. Choose a photo up to 5 MB.
changeImage.photoQuota: The photo storage limit has been reached. Remove unused photos or contact support.
changeImage.photoStorage: Photo storage is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
changeImage.photoConflict: The photo changed on another device. Close this window and reopen it before saving.
changeImage.legacyInfo: This older photo is stored only on this phone. Choose Upload this photo to sync it.
changeImage.cameraPermission: Allow camera access in your phone settings to take a photo.
changeImage.cameraFailed: Could not open the camera. Please try again.
changeImage.pickerFailed: Could not open the photo picker. Please try again.
changeImage.framingHint: Drag to move the photo. Pinch or use the zoom controls to adjust it.
changeImage.photoLoadFailed: Could not load this photo. Choose it again.
changeImage.framingUnsupported: Photo positioning is not available on the server yet. Please update the server and try again.
